run_gradio_demo: run the gradio demo to generate photorealistic avatar videos from microphone audio input
generate_sequences_face_or_pose: generate face or pose motion sequences using the diffusion model with guidance and nucleus sampling
generate_results_from_audio: process audio input and generate normalized face and pose motion results as numpy arrays
audio_to_avatar_render: convert recorded audio into rendered photorealistic avatar MP4 videos using the body renderer
setup_gradiomodel: initialize the GradioModel with face and pose diffusion checkpoints and a body renderer
